title: Output of AI Extract
description: One row per page in the default dataset with the extracted JSON in "data"; a run summary in the OUTPUT record. Free-plan caps and early stops are explained in a free status row.

results.title: Extracted pages
results.description: Example: {"url":"https://example.com/product/1","status":"ok","title":"Blue Mug","data":{"name":"Blue Mug","price":12.5,"currency":"USD","inStock":true}}. Failed pages are free rows with status (fetch_error, ai_error…) and error.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: JSON: pagesProcessed, extracted, charged, byStatus, truncated, freePlanLimited, notice, zeroResultsReason, stoppedBecause and token/AI-cost stats.
